sources.excerpt: ia as a ‘Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic’ with a Parliamentary form of Government. The Constitution of India is the supreme legal authority which binds the legislative, executive, and judicial organs of government. The Constitution grants all citizens Fundamental Rights and empowers the independent judiciary to invalidate legislations or government actions which violate the Constitution.
